basic_cast.name: Basic Cast
basic_cast.desc: Quick wand flick releasing a sparkling bolt of magic.

stupefy.name: Stupefy
stupefy.desc: Stunning spell. Hits target, deals high damage and stuns for up to 1.8 seconds.

incendio.name: Incendio
incendio.desc: Roaring cone of magical fire. Blast damage to everything in the cone, then burns over 3 seconds. Extra damage against Inferi.

bombarda.name: Bombarda
bombarda.desc: Detonates a violent concussive shockwave. Heavy AOE damage with knockback.

expelliarmus.name: Expelliarmus
expelliarmus.desc: Disarming charm. Knocks back the target, interrupts casting and reduces its attack power by 35% for 5 seconds.

protego.name: Protego
protego.desc: Shimmering forcefield. Projectiles that strike it are reflected at their caster; all other damage is reduced by 60%.

ultimate.name: Avada Arcana
ultimate.desc: Ultimate forbidden sorcery. Calls forth blinding emerald lightning that disintegrates targets in a wide blast radius.
